prerequisites: To enroll in this course, it is necessary to have passed or be enrolled in all subjects from courses below the one in which this subject is located.

learning_outcomes.text: Ability to calculate and design thermal installations.
Understand the basic aspects of thermal machines.
Understand the basic aspects of HVAC equipment.
Understand the basic aspects of renewable energies.

syllabus_topics: Components of a heating and DHW installation
Components of an air conditioning installation
Concept of Fluid. Basic principles: Viscosity, Pressure. Saturation pressure. Cavitation
Continuity Equation. Energy Equation. Bernoulli with losses
The three fundamental problems in pipes
Basics of air flow in ducts
Pressure drop in ducts (friction and dynamic losses)
Principles and considerations of air duct design
Duct sizing (equal friction, constant velocity, and static regain methods)
Principles of air distribution in rooms
Types of Cold Water/Domestic Hot Water Installation

assessment_methods.method: Final continuous assessment test (Thermal Installations Part)
Final continuous assessment test (Fluid Installations Part)

assessment_rules: Students can freely choose between Global or Continuous evaluation. For Continuous Evaluation, the final grade is calculated from four blocks: Project (Thermal Installations, 15%), Project (Fluid Installations, 15%), Final Continuous Assessment Test (Thermal Installations, 35%), and Final Continuous Assessment Test (Fluid Installations, 35%). Each block must score above 40% to count; if the total sum is over 5 but a minimum score is not met in any block, the final grade will be 4.0. For Global Evaluation, a single final exam accounts for 100% of the grade. In the second opportunity (resit) call, the same methodology applies: a new final assessment test for continuous evaluation students, and a new final exam for global evaluation students, with previous continuous evaluation scores being retained. Unethical behavior (copying, plagiarism, unauthorized electronic devices) will result in a failing grade of 0.0.
